data.description: Our 5 ft Straight Tunnel Slide runs a red and yellow enclosed tube straight down from a steel tower. It gives children the thrill of a tunnel without the turns of a spiral, so the ride is quick and direct. The closed tube means children cannot slip over the side on the way down. A straight run is easier to fit along the edge of a garden or school ground than a spiral, and supervisors can see the tower and the exit from one spot. Both the tower pipes and the tunnel mouldings are under warranty for 3 years. Send us your site measurements and we will place it on a layout drawing.

items.pText: Our 5 ft Straight Tunnel Slide runs a red and yellow enclosed tube straight down from a steel tower. It gives children the thrill of a tunnel without the turns of a spiral, so the ride is quick and direct. The closed tube means children cannot slip over the side on the way down. A straight run is easier to fit along the edge of a garden or school ground than a spiral, and supervisors can see the tower and the exit from one spot. Both the tower pipes and the tunnel mouldings are under warranty for 3 years. Send us your site measurements and we will place it on a layout drawing.

A galvanised steel tower supports the moulded tunnel sections. Installation is self-standing or grouted, chosen to suit the ground. Keep the exit clear and laid with rubber flooring, check the tunnel joints and tower steps at each maintenance visit, and clear any leaves or water from inside the tube after rain.
